seatCorrections.provenance: SOURCE CORRECTION (approved, Oct 2026). The source prints this consolation wrestle-in as "Randall 10-2" over "Alan Housner - Purdue". Housner is structurally impossible: per the 1976 NCAA Official Wrestling Guide (Guide 39) he pinned Bercier in the preliminaries, beat Randall (R1) and Casper (R2), won his quarterfinal and lost his semifinal, remaining on the championship side through the semifinal. Guy Bercier (Boston University) is identified BY BRACKET TOPOLOGY ONLY as the sole eligible opponent (Housner's only other pre-R2 victim). The winner (Randall) and the result 10-2 are retained AS PRINTED; the 10-2 score is NOT independently confirmed as a Randall-Bercier result.

_note_seatCorrections: Seat-specific source corrections: apply only when year, weight, location and the EXACT printed seat text all match, and only if the corrected wrestler is the one the bracket structure requires in that seat. The printed text is preserved in provenance. Location 'sc1' (first-round consolation seat) targets the seat by its index and places the wrestler by exact record name (no school-prefix matching). Location 'consPigtailLoser' (1975) replaces the loser of one printed consolation wrestle-in, matched by exact printed winner, printed loser (name - school) and printed result.
